Both embeds show a PDF of 14 pages and over 128 KB, made of seven copies of
`sample.pdf` with `pdfunite` (`pdfinfo` and `wc -c` give its size). `files/large-2.pdf` is a copy of
`files/large.pdf`. PDF.js loads a PDF of this size by byte ranges when the
server allows it, so the checks in `tests/` use this page to check that path.
